# Reconciliation table (generated by reconcile.py; every number from code)

kappa_PHOS columns: **sim** = stored time-domain result (erf estimator, 2^16 samples, normalised by the same-record open-loop reference); **replica** = deterministic re-computation of the sim protocol; **exact-per** = exact periodic steady state, sim physics, same accumulator side, sim normalisation; **8lam-rat** = exact rational alpha=i/1000 (floor), ideal model, 8 x min Re eig; **8lam-erg** = ergodic harmonic sum (irrational limit), min over modes; **m1-erg** = mode 1 only; **1-line** = 0.9496 Re H(alpha f_ref).

kappa_GOS columns: **sim** = mS_gg / open-loop (open-loop includes the regressor DC: ~(1-a)<c^2> = 0.97/3); **12C-erg** = ergodic theory normalised by var(rho)=1/12 (loops/regressors convention). 12C-erg / sim ~ 4.

LS kinf = large-signal (A >> sigma_v) 1-bit-correlation, worst direction.
